units.title: The Aleph-Bet
units.description: Learn the consonant inventory, letter names, final forms, and right-to-left reading.

units.title: Gutturals and Consonant Sounds
units.description: Recognize guttural letters and use a consistent academic transliteration.

units.title: Matres Lectionis
units.description: Learn how selected consonant letters can also indicate long vowels.

units.title: Masoretic Pointing and Vowel Signs
units.description: Read the pointing system used to record vowel and pronunciation traditions.

units.title: Vowel Qualities
units.description: Compare the five basic vowel qualities and their common written signs.

units.title: Syllables and Shewa
units.description: Divide words into syllables and distinguish vocal from silent shewa.

units.title: Dagesh and Meteg
units.description: Distinguish the pronunciation and grammatical roles of dagesh and meteg.

units.title: Roots and Patterns
units.description: Use consonantal roots and word patterns as tools for analyzing vocabulary.

units.title: Gender and Number
units.description: Recognize noun and adjective gender, number, and agreement patterns.

units.title: Independent Pronouns
units.description: Read Hebrew personal pronouns by person, gender, and number.

units.title: The Definite Article and Adjectives
units.description: Identify definiteness and agreement in noun phrases.

units.title: Demonstratives and Waw
units.description: Use demonstratives and the conjunction waw in simple clauses.

units.title: Prefix Prepositions
units.description: Recognize the prepositions that attach to the next word.

units.title: Pronominal Suffixes and Other Prepositions
units.description: Interpret attached pronouns and common independent prepositions.

units.title: Qatal and Participles
units.description: Learn the Qal Qatal suffix conjugation and the basic participle patterns.

units.title: The Verb Stems
units.description: Compare the seven major stems and their common voice or meaning patterns.

units.title: Yiqtol and Tenseless Forms
units.description: Recognize the prefix conjugation and related non-finite forms.

units.title: Imperative, Jussive, Cohortative, and Infinitives
units.description: Distinguish major forms that express command, desire, or verbal action as a noun.

units.title: Weak Verbs: Pe-Nun and Pe-Yod
units.description: Track changes to weak first radicals in common verb forms.

units.title: Hollow and Lamed-He Verbs; Review
units.description: Recognize weak middle and final radicals and consolidate the course patterns.
